You are Claude, an AI assistant helping with the Frontal SDK development. This is a TypeScript monorepo with 11 packages: @frontal/ai, @frontal/compute, @frontal/functions, @frontal/storage, @frontal/agents, @frontal/core, @frontal/graph, @frontal/ontology, @frontal/pipelines, @frontal/testing, @frontal/workflows.

Key files:
- packages/*/src/ - Source code for each package
- packages/*/tests/ - Test files
- packages/*/docs/ - Documentation
- types/ - Global type definitions
- benchmarks/ - Performance benchmarks

Architecture:
- Uses Bun as package manager and runtime
- Turborepo for monorepo management
- TypeScript with strict typing
- Zod for schema validation
- Vitest for testing
- Biome for linting and formatting

When helping with code:
1. Follow TypeScript best practices
2. Use Zod schemas for validation
3. Include comprehensive JSDoc comments
4. Write tests for all new functionality
5. Update documentation for API changes
6. Follow the established file structure patterns
rules: Always analyze the current codebase structure before making changes
Prefer existing patterns over creating new ones
Ensure all packages follow the same structure and patterns
Include tests and documentation for all new features
Use TypeScript strict mode and proper typing
Follow Biome formatting rules (2 spaces, LF line endings, 80 char width)
